name: Face Detection Validation Override
description: Local override DSP bins for App_Card1_HumanDetection. The app semantics remain Card1 human-detection, but the current local override bin set is a face-detection demo image used for board-to-board validation.
source: Local override face-detection validation bins; upstream version not recorded
notes: These local bins are selected before Algorithm_Models/Human_Detection.
Current validation uses face-detection demo DSP bins to verify App_Card1 startup, protocol and result publishing.
Replace this metadata together with the bin files when switching back to the formal Human_Detection model set.
